name: GitHub
_comment: oauth-device ships with an empty client_id on purpose: Fused still has to register a GitHub OAuth App with device flow enabled. Until then FUSED_RENDER_CONNECT_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID fills it, and the card offers the gh CLI and a personal access token.
privacy: Sign-in and every call go straight from this computer to GitHub. With the GitHub CLI the token stays in the CLI's own store; otherwise it stays on this computer. Fused runs no server in this flow.
